C2_method_protocol.candidate: EWRA requires a jointly sealed state model, observation map, representation domain, action restriction, history rule, and OOA convention before an exact-world verdict is reported.
C2_method_protocol.load_bearing_output: A verdict can be reclassified from negative to OOA/undefined when domain closure is absent.
C2_method_protocol.minimal_counterexample: A reachability routine queried outside its declared representation domain returns no witness. A bare negative report is false as a domain statement; an explicit OOA guard returns OOA.
C2_method_protocol.adversarial_question: Can ordinary model checking plus a domain precondition and provenance log produce the same corrected output?
C2_method_protocol.pre_literature_status: LIKELY_COMPOSITION; no nonstandard invariant yet established

C3_audit_instrument.candidate: A coupled certificate reports alias, closure, reachability, witness, and residue together rather than a single success/failure bit.
C3_audit_instrument.load_bearing_output: The certificate locates whether an apparent failure is observation aliasing, an action-domain exclusion, or OOA.
C3_audit_instrument.minimal_counterexample: Two procedures share an aggregate success rate but differ on a single OOA context. A capability-labelled test table distinguishes them.
C3_audit_instrument.adversarial_question: Does a standard labelled test suite plus per-property verification yield the identical diagnosis?
C3_audit_instrument.pre_literature_status: LIKELY_COMPOSITION; no new measured quantity yet established

C4_benchmark.candidate: A three-tier exact-world benchmark contrasts observation coarsening, representation closure, action restriction, reuse validity, and OOA on the same interface.
C4_benchmark.load_bearing_output: A system's apparent generalization can be separated into a valid certificate, a counterexample, or an OOA boundary.
C4_benchmark.minimal_counterexample: Two systems agree on all aggregate tasks but one fails a deliberately labelled surface-fixed action selector; a per-property benchmark separates them.
C4_benchmark.adversarial_question: Are these simply ordinary coverage dimensions of verification and planning benchmarks once the labels are supplied?
C4_benchmark.pre_literature_status: UNPROVEN; requires an external test-design difference, not a new naming scheme

C5_empirical_resource.candidate: The P34 bank supplies exact, prospectively ordered contexts and negative/OOA residue for an audit corpus.
C5_empirical_resource.load_bearing_output: A future user can reproduce a bounded certificate and its failure boundary.
C5_empirical_resource.minimal_counterexample: A second exact finite-state corpus with the same metadata schema yields the same audit outputs; the cube bank alone then adds no method-level scientific output.
C5_empirical_resource.adversarial_question: Does the bank establish an independently interesting empirical phenomenon rather than furnish one worked finite-state fixture?

precommitment: No class is promotable unless a non-compositional invariant changes a capability, coupling, falsifier, measurement, or certificate output after the strongest actual prior-art composition is granted.
